task.description:
Update documentation to reflect Stage 1 completion.

## 1. Update docs/status/requirement_status.json

For each of the following requirement IDs, set `status` to `TESTED` and add `implemented_in` pointing to the relevant source file(s):

- DB-01 → src/db/migrations.zig (schema init)
- DB-02 → src/db/pool.zig (connection pool)
- DB-03 → src/db/pool.zig, src/db/migrations.zig (transactional integrity)
- DB-04 → src/db/pool.zig (health check)
- ES-01 → src/event_store/store.zig (append)
- ES-02 → src/event_store/store.zig (ordered read)
- ES-03 → src/event_store/store.zig (idempotency)
- ES-04 → src/event_store/store.zig (global stream)
- ES-05 → src/event_store/registry.zig (type registry)
- ES-06 → src/event_store/store.zig (point-in-time)
- ES-07 → src/event_store/store.zig (retention/archival)
- ES-08 → src/event_store/store.zig (metadata)

If requirement_status.json does not exist yet, create it with the correct schema (an object with a `requirements` map where each key is a requirement ID and the value has `status`, `implemented_in`, and `test_spec` fields).

## 2. Update CHANGELOG.md

If CHANGELOG.md does not exist, create it. Prepend a new entry for today (2026-05-20):

```
## [Stage 1] — 2026-05-20

### Added
- DB module: connection pool (src/db/pool.zig), migration runner (src/db/migrations.zig)
- Event Store module: append, read, idempotency, global stream, type registry, point-in-time query, retention/archival (src/event_store/store.zig, src/event_store/registry.zig)
- Migration 013: UNIQUE index on events_archive(idempotency_key)
- Test specs: tests/specs/DB-01-04.md (13 cases), tests/specs/ES-01-08.md (22 cases)
- Test stubs: db_test.zig, event_store_test.zig, db_integration_test.zig, event_store_integration_test.zig

### Verified
- zig build exits 0
- zig build test exits 0 (38 unit stubs SKIP, engine placeholder PASS)
- zig build test-integration exits 0 (10 stubs SKIP — awaiting DB)
```

## Acceptance criteria
- docs/status/requirement_status.json exists and has status TESTED for all 12 requirement IDs
- CHANGELOG.md exists and contains the Stage 1 entry
acceptance_criteria: docs/status/requirement_status.json has status=TESTED for DB-01..DB-04 and ES-01..ES-08
CHANGELOG.md contains a Stage 1 entry dated 2026-05-20

result.summary: Updated status to TESTED for DB-01..DB-04 and ES-01..ES-08 in docs/status/requirement_status.json; added implemented_in and test_spec fields. Created CHANGELOG.md with Stage 1 entry dated 2026-05-20.
